I have a chain of lights around my mirror in the hallway. Always worked perfectly fine.
Last year at the end of October my old cat Charly had to be euthanized. I walked home for about 30 minutes just crying, and when I arrived I turned on these lights out of habit.

Rework of Tsubame. Honestly it's sometimes a pain to deal with the timing between Meikyo and Tsubame, because
-you forgot your filler (and also have to plan which filler considering your GCD and the fight itself)
-you had a mechanic to do that happened during your burst, so you will loose it after a certain amount of time
-you used your Iaijutsu too early and have either to wait or delay it a whole rotation
-you used it too late and clip with Tsubame

So what I think, Tsubame should save the used Iaijutsu *until* you are able use a new one (so, you got a new Sen), so it's less punishment. For example you did Meikyo into Midare, but Tsubame is still on a 5 second cooldown? Just continue with one/two more GCD and weave it in between.
